'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Brian Fred LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
